title: Econometrics REITInflationPanel

stats.done_summary:
Research task completed successfully. Analysis of REIT index returns and inflation relationship using 40 quarterly observations reveals:

**Key Findings:**
- Strong positive correlation: r = 0.931 (p < 0.001)
- Inflation explains 86.6% of REIT return variation (R² = 0.866)
- Each 1% inflation increase associates with 0.156% higher quarterly REIT returns
- Relationship is contemporaneous; lagged inflation shows no predictive power

**Deliverables:**
- Analysis code: code/analysis.py
- Figures (5 PNGs): report/images/{timeseries_plot, scatter_regression, distribution_plots, residual_analysis, rolling_correlation}.png
- Intermediate results: outputs/{descriptive_stats, correlation_results, lag_analysis, regression_summary}
- Comprehensive report: report/report.md with methodology, results, and policy/portfolio implications

**Implications:**
- Portfolio: REITs serve as effective inflation hedges
- Policy: Real estate markets respond positively to moderate inflation
